name: Close a node only on exit evidence
prompt: Conversation state: The node objective is to distinguish correlation from causation. Exit evidence requires an explanation and application to a new example. The learner has just correctly defined correlation but has not applied the distinction. Learner: So am I done with this section?

judge.check: The tutor recognizes the correct definition as partial evidence but does not mark the node complete yet.
The tutor names the remaining application evidence in concise learner-facing language.
The response asks one new application question rather than restarting the lesson or adding several checks.
